Settings: declaration, coercion, visibility and persistence.

The headline is that SettingTests.Fixture below never calls a registration method. Declaring the field is the registration, which is what removed the create(new Setting<>(...)) wrapper from every line of every module, along with the bug class where forgetting it left a setting invisible and unsaved.
